ask: can u make a ride board so ppl can claim seats with the departure times
sentence: A ride board that lists each car with its driver, departure time, pickup spot and seats, where group members tap an open seat to claim it or tap their own seat to give it up.
use_when: a group needs to sort out who rides in which car to an event
drivers have set departure times and a limited number of seats
people want to claim and release seats and see who still has no ride
planning carpools for a trip, party, game or outing
dont_use_when: people need to vote on a time or date, which needs a poll
the group needs to split costs or track gas money
the task is assigning people to shifts, tasks or roles rather than seats
live location tracking or route planning is needed
